canonical_json.hash_preimage: ASCII hash-domain bytes, one 0x00 byte, then canonical JSON bytes without a trailing newline
canonical_json.map: ordered array of typed key/value entries, never a JSON object
canonical_json.missing_null_value: missing omits the field; null emits JSON null; value emits exactly one canonical payload
canonical_json.numbers: only schema-declared integer metadata fields use canonical base-10 JSON tokens through their exact u8/u16/u32/u64 range; semantic i64/u64 values use decimal strings; no fraction, exponent, plus, negative zero, or redundant leading zero
canonical_json.object_member_order: schema-declared order; boundary value fields use boundary-contract order
canonical_json.strings: shortest UTF-8 for Unicode scalars; quote and reverse-solidus use two-byte escapes; U+0000..U+001F and lone UTF-16 surrogates use lowercase \uXXXX; slash is unescaped; short control escapes are forbidden
canonical_json.sum: object members tag then payload; payload is present only for a payload-carrying active arm

atoms.canonical_id: nonempty printable ASCII, maximum 1024 UTF-8 bytes, grammar fixed by owning schema
atoms.closed_canonical_value: value closed by its admitted type and canonical JSON codec
atoms.closed_source_type_id: canonical source type identity admitted by the selected closed compilation
atoms.closed_type_id: canonical monomorphic source or registered semantic-instance type identity
atoms.contract_binding_id: contract-local or subject binding identity declared in the enclosing contract
atoms.contract_expression_bool: contract_expression whose checked type_id is Bool
atoms.contract_local_binding_id: contract-local binding identity introduced exactly once by let or a bounded quantifier
atoms.diagnostic_phase: canonical JSON integer equal to one phase ID in diagnostics.phase_precedence
atoms.local_or_construction_state_id: declared local or unique construction-state identity in the selected callable
atoms.normalized_relative_path: portable normalized repository-relative path with no empty, dot, dot-dot, absolute, or backslash component
atoms.normalized_sidecar_path: normalized_relative_path under the selected verification-overlay sidecar root ending .json
atoms.registered_artifact_schema_id: the exact schema identity required by the enclosing artifact_ref type argument
atoms.registered_codec_id: one codec ID in the frozen parse/format profile
atoms.registered_codec_id_or_null: JSON null or one codec ID in the frozen parse/format profile
atoms.registered_codec_mode_id: one mode admitted by the selected registered codec
atoms.registered_operation_id: one operation ID admitted by the frozen closed operation profile
atoms.registered_semantic_binding_id: one binding ID in the context-bound validated semantic-binding set
atoms.registered_semantic_parameters_schema_id: one exact parameters schema selected by the validated semantic-profile entry
atoms.registered_sidecar_schema_id: one exact strict sidecar schema admitted by the selected semantic context
atoms.registered_sum_arm_id: one arm ID declared by the checked closed type_id
atoms.schema_selected_strict_object: strict object selected by semantic_parameters_envelope.schema; for the practical profile this is csharp_practical_parameter_values_v1
atoms.selection_envelope: strict selection object whose schema, shape, and hash domain are selected by the validated semantic-profile entry; for the practical profile this is mpk.selection.csharp_members.v1
atoms.source_command_arm_id: one declared arm of the bound application-owned command sum
atoms.source_result_arm_id: one declared arm of the bound application-owned result sum
atoms.utf16_string: JSON string decoded to an exact finite UTF-16 code-unit sequence under canonical_json.strings
atoms.well_founded_contract_expression: contract_expression whose checked type and order prove a strict well-founded decrease

schema_type_system.collection_rules: arrays preserve declared order unless the type says sorted_unique; duplicates reject before hashing

type_constructors.artifact_ref<T>: artifact_ref whose schema field is the exact successor identity T
type_constructors.literal<x>: the exact JSON scalar or ASCII identity x and no other value
type_constructors.ordered_array<T>: possibly empty array of T preserving declared order
type_constructors.ordered_nonempty_array<T>: nonempty array of T preserving declared order
type_constructors.ordered_unique_array<T>: possibly empty array of pairwise-distinct T preserving declared order
type_constructors.sorted_nonempty_unique_array<T>: nonempty array of pairwise-distinct T in ascending canonical-byte order
type_constructors.sorted_unique_array<T>: possibly empty array of pairwise-distinct T in ascending canonical-byte order

semantic_context_binding.context_repetition: every repeated semantic_context is field-complete equal to the validated request context
semantic_context_binding.entry_lookup: profile_entry_sha256 must resolve exactly one entry in the referenced immutable profile_registry revision
semantic_context_binding.validated_request_selection: selection schema, strict shape, and hash domain must equal profile_entry.selection_schema

termination.bounded_quantifiers: finite bounds evaluated before body traversal
termination.loops: every admitted loop has invariant and well-founded decreases proof
termination.static_networks: finite counts checked before generation; balanced composition depth is bounded

transition.event_rule: the bounded immutable event sequence preserves source append order exactly

idempotency.eviction: none; full history returns the declared capacity error
idempotency.source_equality: field-complete source equality proved equivalent to exact canonical field encodings

transition.response_rule: new success uses the computed response; replay uses the complete stored response
